caption_L1: Number of practicing pharmacists employed in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2002 to 2019 is a line chart. Year is drawn as a linear scale with a minimum of 2005 and a maximum of 2015 along the x-axis. A linear scale of range 0 to 60,000 can be seen on the y-axis, marked Number of employees.
caption_L2L3: Between 2002 and 2010 the number of pharmacists increased by 5,000. There was a large increase of nearly 10,000 between 2010 and 2011/12. Between 2017 and 2019 there was a decline in the number of pharmacists of a few 1,000. The peak number of pharmacists was in 2017 of 60,000.
